name: v27-d-09-commit-hold
objective: v2.7 09 option E live (D) row, no model. A mocked read (storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse through the extract verb) proposes took_job=true while the player's only line refuses it ('I don't take the job, not yet.'): the commit guard holds the reading, the story stays at the offer, and the session journal (the so-journal show read, via getSessionJournal) carries the held row with its reason '(negated)' and the player's own line ('the player wrote "I don't take the job, not yet."'). Control: a later line that does take it commits through the same mocked read and the story moves on, so the guard is not blanket. The row is author detail: player mode never shows it. Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-d-09-commit-hold.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator" (a no-model lane: st-lanes.mts no-model <n>).

requires.why: the read is mocked (extract debugResponse); the subject is the commit guard's held journal row, not extraction quality (the real-play leg is v2.8 01 O11)

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so the message ids below would name the wrong line`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

import_story.title: SO-V27D Commitment Hold
import_story.description: v2.7 live (D) fixture: a commitment quality the player has to say in their own words.

qualities.rubric: Has the player accepted the guild's job?

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); if (!rt.getSnapshot().ready) throw new Error(`the story did not load: ${rt.getSnapshot().status}`); if (!SillyTavern.getContext().groupId) throw new Error('not a group chat'); return { cadence: 0, storyId: rt.getSnapshot().storyId };

steps.send: I don't take the job, not yet.

steps.slash: /sendas name=Ponticius The guild will wait for your answer.

extract.debugResponse: DELTA q=took_job value=true evidence="I don't take the job"

steps.eval: const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const held = await until(() => rt.getSessionJournal().find((event) => JSON.stringify(event).includes('commitment reading')), 5000, 'a held commitment row in the journal'); const strings = []; const walk = (value) => { if (typeof value === 'string') strings.push(value); else if (value && typeof value === 'object') Object.values(value).forEach(walk); }; walk(held); const text = strings.join(' '); if (!text.includes('took_job') || !text.includes('(negated)')) throw new Error(`the held row does not give the reason: ${text}`); if (!text.includes('the player wrote "I don\'t take the job, not yet."')) throw new Error(`the held row does not quote the player's line: ${text}`); if (rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId !== 'offer') throw new Error(`the refusal moved the story: ${rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId}`); if (rt.getEngineState().blackboard.values.took_job === true) throw new Error('the refusal committed took_job'); return { held: held.summary, detail: held.detail ?? null };

steps.slash: /sendas name=Ponticius Then we leave at dawn.

extract.debugResponse: DELTA q=took_job value=true evidence="I take the job"

steps.eval: const text = document.querySelector('#drawer-manager')?.textContent ?? ''; if (/negated|took_job|the player wrote/.test(text)) throw new Error('player mode shows the held row\'s author detail'); return { playerClean: true };
